name: BoostHand
summary: A virtual hand with switchable non-linear mapping that reaches distant objects in AR classrooms.
howItWorks: The user can switch the hand mapping from one-to-one to an amplified mode, so small hand movements reach objects far away, then grasp them.

relationships.note: Non-linear reach extension, as in Go-Go.
